name: spark-lens
description: A browser dashboard for a small local-AI lab: DGX Sparks, the dev machine, local LLMs, cloud LLM subscriptions and coding agents.

scripts.check: pnpm typecheck && pnpm test && pnpm build
scripts.scan:secrets: docker run --rm --user "$(id -u):$(id -g)" -v "$PWD:/repo:ro" ghcr.io/betterleaks/betterleaks:v2.0.0-rc.7 git /repo --include=merges --no-banner --redact && docker run --rm --user "$(id -u):$(id -g)" -v "$PWD:/repo:ro" ghcr.io/betterleaks/betterleaks:v2.0.0-rc.7 fs /repo --no-banner --redact
